description: Fetch recent announcements (news items) from your courses in D2L Brightspace. Can filter to a specific course or get announcements across all courses. Pass course with a name or code when you know it, or courseId when you have the ID. Use this when the user asks about announcements, news, news items, updates from instructors, recent posts, or what professors said in Brightspace or D2L. Example: "Did my professors post anything new?"

count.description: Maximum number of announcements to return

course.description: Course name or code to get announcements for, for example "CS 101". Use this instead of courseId when you know the name.

courseId.description: Course ID to get announcements for. If omitted, returns recent announcements across all courses.

name: get_announcements
title: Get Announcements
